description: Read-only discovery of deployed XRC-729 workflows that a given address can start as owner, executor, or wildcard executor. Use this whenever the user provides an address and asks which sessions/workflows they can start. This tool does not create session-start handoffs.

address.description: EVM wallet, Safe or contract address in 0x-prefixed hexadecimal format.

includeExecutor.description: Value for the include executor parameter.

includeGraph.description: Value for the include graph parameter.

includeOwner.description: Value for the include owner parameter.

includePayloadSchema.description: Value for the include payload schema parameter.

includeWildcard.description: Value for the include wildcard parameter.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return.

network.description: Target network name or environment, for example mainnet or devnet.

owner.description: EVM address of the XDaLa session owner or relevant account.

name: find_startable_xdala_workflows

data.description: Structured result data returned by the XGR MCP gateway.

title: Find startable XDaLa workflows
